chunks: We surely tried Solomon, and placed another body on his throne. So he turned to God
ai.seo_question: What was the nature of the trial imposed upon Prophet Solomon in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'body' (jasad) cast upon Solomon's throne is often interpreted as a period of temporary inactivity or a physical trial that tested his prophetic endurance, highlighting the distinction between his spiritual station and physical state. This event underscores the theme of divine testing (fitnah) even for infallible prophets, leading to their immediate return (inabah) to God, a concept central to understanding their perfection in submission.
